non_latin.basis: Unicode block count of Experiment 33 reference transcriptions, 2026-09-30 (ADR-071 erratum)

oracle_O.rule: share of the 399 gated pages with body_recall < 0.5

prior_look: author counted letters by Unicode block over saved text of io01, io02, io03, io07, io06, rf06, mx01, pooled per document, before writing this plan; no candidate scored per page

candidates.C0: escalate on empty or whitespace text, confidence < 0.8 or None, or hosted_recommended (shipped ADR-069 post-check)

C1.rule: escalate when CJK share >= 0.05 or output empty
C1.threshold_reason: stray CJK in Latin-script output about 0.0001 of letters; 0.05 is 500 times above

C4.target: AUC, io06 body_recall < 0.5 against modern Latin print body_recall >= 0.8

G2.rule: kept pages with body_recall < 0.5 / kept pages <= 0.05, population without io06 (333)

G3.reason: O is the floor; 0.05 is about 20 wasted worker calls (about 13 min at 38.2 s per page); below the 0.9 cut's 0.597

selection: lowest escalated share among passing candidates; tie to the simpler rule: C0, C1, C3

reproduction_check.source: Experiment 33 report, confidence calibration table, cut 0.8

decision_register.decision: C4 operational definitions, fixed before any rule is scored. Positives: io06 gated pages with body_recall < 0.5. Negatives: rows outside io06, io01, io02, io03 and io07 with body_recall >= 0.8 (modern Latin print). Signal direction: a higher discarded-region count and a lower chars per page mean more likely positive. AUC is reported one-sided in that direction and two-sided as max(AUC, 1 - AUC). The follow-up trigger (AUC >= 0.8) reads the one-sided value.
decision_register.reason: The plan names the two populations without a document list or a direction. C4 is exploratory and no gate depends on it.

decision_register.decision: Run against the saved texts and the freeze check in the v3 worktree, passed with --e33-dir. The rows file hash is checked against source_data.rows_sha256.
decision_register.reason: The 464 saved texts and the corpus PDFs are gitignored. They exist in the v3 worktree only. freeze.py --check fails in this worktree because the corpus is missing, and prints 'freeze verified' in v3.
